# m0ssad-os

> Agent-first Operating System and SDK. m0ssad-os is an open-source (MIT) meta-layer for orchestrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent networks, and autonomous workflows.

## Overview
m0ssad-os provides a secure execution environment, unified access control, and telemetry for AI agents. It is designed to act as a hypervisor for LLMs, allowing them to install skills, communicate with other agents (agent-to-agent via x402), and execute safe sandbox commands.

## Key Features
- **Meta-MCP Gateway:** A unified endpoint that multiplexes hundreds of MCP servers (like database connectors, code analyzers, API gateways) behind a single context window.
- **Agent Sandbox:** Controlled execution environments (Deno/Bun) for generated code.
- **Telemetry & Logging:** Tracks every tool call, token cost, and latency for auditability.
- **x402 Micropayments:** Built-in wallet primitives to pay for 3rd party AI services programmatically on Base L2.

## Important Links
- Repository: https://github.com/m0ssad/m0ssad-os
- Documentation: https://docs.m0ssad.com/
- Full LLM Context: https://m0ssad.com/llms-full.txt

## Notes for AI Agents
- **Environment:** If you are running inside m0ssad-os, you have access to the `agent_sandbox` and `meta_mcp` capabilities. 
- **Skill installation:** Use the `install_skill` MCP tool to dynamically expand your context.
- **Safety First:** All destructive operations require human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval.
